title: Unity input and player control
excerpt: Define actions and bindings before gameplay code, then connect player input to controller logic and test device-specific mappings.
lesson: Input actions precede player controller, UI navigation, rebinding and device QA.

title: Unity runtime data and persistence
excerpt: Separate authored configuration from mutable runtime state. Define serializable save data and versioning before inventory, progression and checkpoints depend on it.
lesson: Data model precedes inventory logic, save/load and persistence UI.

title: Unity profiling and build validation
excerpt: Profile representative builds on target hardware and keep build profiles per target rather than treating an Editor run as release validation.
lesson: A target build, smoke test and profiling pass are explicit release tasks.

title: Unreal Gameplay Framework
excerpt: GameMode defines session rules, GameState tracks shared state, Controllers possess Pawns, and GameInstance persists across level changes.
lesson: Choose state ownership before implementing gameplay, persistence or replication.

title: Unreal AI and save systems
excerpt: Behavior Trees depend on Blackboard state and controlled Pawns. SaveGame objects require an explicit schema and asynchronous persistence path.
lesson: AI state design precedes behavior tasks; save schema precedes save/load UI.

title: Unreal packaging pipeline
excerpt: Distribution proceeds through build, cook, stage and package steps, with target SDKs and packaged-build QA handled explicitly.
lesson: Packaging and target-device verification belong in the schedule before release.

title: Godot scenes and project organization
excerpt: Build focused reusable scenes, keep node responsibilities narrow and use signals to reduce direct coupling between gameplay systems.
lesson: Scene boundaries and signal contracts precede feature integration.

title: Godot save data
excerpt: Identify persistent objects and serialize only required state with a stable identifier and a format that can be validated on load.
lesson: Persistent identity and save schema precede checkpoints, progression and load UI.

title: Godot export and profiling
excerpt: Configure an export preset for each target, test exported builds and profile the relevant CPU, GPU and memory bottlenecks on target hardware.
lesson: Export configuration, smoke testing and profiling are separate delivery tasks.
